title: The operator-control CLI and pause tests claim more than they run: pauseCli re-implements the CLI HTTP flow in the test, preflightCli's header promises mocked unit tests that do not exist and its honeypot-checker case passes on any failure line, and the pauseFlow restart case asserts neither listeners nor exit monitors

evidence.note: header: Tests 1, 2, 5 prove "the END-TO-END ... flow that the CLI exercises"

loginAndPost re-implements scripts/pause.ts with axios in the test ("structurally IDENTICAL"); scripts/pause.ts and resume.ts are only grepped (:307-392) and spawned once for the missing-key exit (:263-299)
header: "Test 2 + Test 3 (unit-level exit-code semantics): static-import the scripts/preflight.ts code path via a mocked preflightDryRun"; all four tests spawn the real CLI instead
Test 3 "prints honeypot-checker FAIL when getCode returns 0x" uses an unreachable RPC and accepts /honeypot-checker-code|Preflight failed|FAIL /
title: "chain listeners attached AND dashboard reachable AND exit monitors running AND ... CP1 fires"

assertions: preflight, buildChainRegistry and startApiServer called, CP1 log, no submit, and startExitMonitor NOT called; startDexListenerSpy (:515) is never wired or asserted; the pause state comes from a mocked getPauseState, not a persisted row

sibling_sites_checked: The three operator-control test files (pause/resume CLI, preflight CLI, pause flow) and midRunWalletCheck (auto-pause wiring, sound). The CLI scripts themselves are SCRIPTS-slice scope.
severity_rationale: S3: misleading assurance on operator controls; the kill-switch buy gate itself is covered by the V2 killswitch cases and the dashboard routes by real-route tests with mocked statements.
recommendation: Phase 28: run scripts/pause.ts and resume.ts as children (through spawnRailedChild) against the loopback test server; make preflightCli Test 3 assert the honeypot-checker-code line specifically with a reachable stub RPC that returns 0x; give the pauseFlow restart case a persisted pause row and assertions on listeners and resumed monitors; correct the headers.
affected_cases: preflightCli Test 3: subprocess prints honeypot-checker FAIL when getCode returns 0x
